decided_by.quote: You should pay close attention to the assessment brief as this will state what level and type of AI usage is permitted for that particular assessment.
please contact the Module Convenor in the first instance.

duty.quote: The AI Declaration must be submitted with all assessments submitted to, or completed on, Moodle, including those where no AI use is permitted by the Assessment Brief.

contents.quote: A brief description of the prompts you used and the outputs that were generated.
